objectiveText: Take Sara Balloo's note to King Magni Bronzebeard of Ironforge.
Speak with Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
Speak to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
Speak to Mikhail in the Wetlands.
Subdue Tapoke Jahn before he escapes, and then return to Mikhail in Menethil.
Speak to Mikhail in the Wetlands.
Find Commander Samaul in Dustwallow Marsh.
Search Sentry Point for any sign of Private Hendel.
Find Private Hendel in Dustwallow Marsh.
Speak to Jaina Proudmore in Dustwallow Swamp.
Defeat Private Hendel in Dustwallow Marsh.
Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.
Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.
Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.
Speak to Eridan again in a moment.

directives.text: Dashel Stonefist will become hostile after accepting the follow up quest. Defeat him
Dashel Stonefist will also attack with 2 Old Town Thugs. Ignore them and focus on Dashel Stonefist
Be careful as the Old Town Thugs will reset when you defeat Dashel but then become hostile again after returning to their original locations
Accepting this quest will make Tapoke "Slim" Jahn by the Inn entrance [Stealth] and run away outside
Defeat Tapoke "Slim" Jahn. Slim's Friend will run away once Tapoke "Slim" Jahn submits
Use any Crowd Control (CC) on Slim's Friend if needed
Travel to the Sentry Point Tower
Stay in Archmage Tervosh's Line of Sight as he will buff you with [Proudmoore's Defense] which gives 10 Stamina and 40 Armor
Defeat Private Hendel. He will attack you along with 2 Theramore Sentries
They will both reset once you subdue Private Hendel
Talk to Archmage Tervosh first and then to Lady Jaina Proudmoore
Talk to the Fallen Hero of the Horde
Talk to the Fallen Hero of the Horde
Talk to the Fallen Hero of the Horde
Turn in A Tale of Sorrow
Turn in The Torch of Retribution
You may need to wait for the RP
